title: Scaffold Manifest
description: Manifest produced by the implementation_scaffold phase describing all scaffold documents written during a run, the source spec they were generated from, and whether any source files outside the scaffold directory were modified. One scaffold-manifest artifact is registered per scaffold run; individual documents listed under 'documents[]' are typically also registered as scaffold-document artifacts.

manifest_id.description: Unique identifier for this scaffold manifest (e.g. 'scaffold-manifest-pipeline-meta-test-2026-04-10')

run_id.description: Pipeline run ID this scaffold manifest belongs to

phase.description: Phase that produced the manifest. Typically 'implementation_scaffold'.

spec_id.description: ID of the design spec this scaffold elaborates

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the manifest was generated

source_spec.description: Repository-relative path to the source spec JSON file the scaffold was derived from

validation_report.description: Optional repository-relative path to a validation report JSON file associated with the source spec

note.description: Optional free-form note describing the scope, provenance, or status of this scaffold run

documents.description: All scaffold documents produced by this run

changes_applied_to_source.description: True if the scaffold run modified any files in the source tree (not just pipeline_mcp_data/scaffold/)

files_outside_scaffold_modified.description: True if any files outside pipeline_mcp_data/scaffold/ were written during this scaffold run

known_quality_gate_misconfigurations.description: Optional list of known quality-gate misconfigurations surfaced by this scaffold run

ScaffoldDocumentEntry.description: A single scaffold document entry. Mirrors the shape of scaffold-document artifacts with the additional 'path' and 'description' fields that the manifest records for cross-reference.

filename.description: File name of the scaffold document

description.description: Human-readable description of the document's purpose

byte_size.description: Size of the document in bytes. Nullable because some scaffold writers do not record size at generation time.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the document was generated
